title: Extraction run-on
brief: Program an extraction fan that starts immediately but continues running briefly after the demand is removed.
requirements: Extraction Request (I0.0) is ON when extraction is needed. The Extraction Fan (Q0.0) must start immediately when this input turns ON.
While Extraction Request (I0.0) remains ON, Extraction Fan (Q0.0) must remain ON.
When Extraction Request switches OFF, keep Extraction Fan (Q0.0) running for a further 3 seconds, then switch it OFF.
If Extraction Request (I0.0) turns ON again during the 3-second run-on, the fan must continue running without interruption.
When the request eventually switches OFF again, start a fresh full 3-second run-on period. If the request is initially OFF, the fan must initially be OFF.
hints: A TOF output is TRUE immediately when its IN is TRUE.
Connect the request to a TOF and use the instance Q contact to drive the fan coil in a later network.
